Level 1

Shuruaat: board, pieces aur rules

Chess ki soch, board, pieces ki chaal, special moves, check-mate, jeet-draw, notation, tournament rules

  • Yahan se chess ki neev banegi.
  • Har cheez board par khud kar ke seekhoge.
  • Jaldi mat karo: yeh basics pakke hue to aage sab aasaan lagega.
1.1

Chess ki soch: shuruaat se pehle

Quotes, growth mindset, game ke 3 hisse, seekhne ka model

Yaad rakho
  • Har master kabhi beginner tha (Chernev). Haar se jeet se zyada seekhte ho (Capablanca).
  • Achhi chaal dikhe to ruko, behtar chaal dhundo (Lasker).
  • Game ke 3 hisse: opening, middlegame, endgame.
  • Concentric circles model: pehle principles, phir processes aur patterns, phir details aur exceptions.
  • Checkmate sab se upar: mate mil raha ho to queen bhi de sakte ho.

1.1.1 Chess ke famous quotes

  • "Har chess master kabhi beginner tha." (Irving Chernev, "Logical Chess Move by Move" ke lekhak)
  • "Chess, pyaar aur music ki tarah, insaan ko khush kar sakta hai." (Siegbert Tarrasch)
  • "Chess dimaag ka gymnasium hai": roz khelna = roz dimaag ki kasrat.
  • "Jeet se zyada haar se seekhte ho. Achha banne se pehle saikdon games haarne padenge." (Capablanca)
  • "Achhi chaal dikhe to bahut khush mat ho. Ruko aur behtar chaal dhundo." (Emanuel Lasker)
  • "Achha player hamesha lucky hota hai." (Capablanca): jitna strong, utna "luck".
  • "Narm dil se chess nahi khel sakte." (French kahavat): jeetne ki zid chahiye, darr ke draw mat lo.
  • "Blunders board par intezaar kar rahe hain." aur "Jeetta woh hai jo aakhri se pehli galti karta hai." (Tartakower)

1.1.2 Sawal 1: Lasker ki salah

Lasker ki salah: achhi chaal dikhe to kya karo?

Jawab

✓ Ruko aur behtar chaal dhundo

  • Pehli achhi chaal aksar best nahi hoti.
  • Ek second aur socho.

1.1.3 Sawal 2: Tartakower ke hisaab se game kaun jeetta hai?

Tartakower ke hisaab se game kaun jeetta hai?

Jawab

✓ Jo aakhri se pehli galti karta hai

  • Dono galtiyan karte hain.
  • Jo aakhri galti nahi karta, woh jeetta hai.
  • Isliye haar maan ke mat baitho.

1.1.4 Growth mindset: haar = sabak

  • Haar ko learning samjho, sharm nahi. Har haare game mein ek sabak chhupa hai.
  • Har game ke baad pucho: kahan galti hui, kyun hui, agli baar kya karunga?
  • Rating upar-neeche hoti rahegi. Lagaataar seekhte raho, result apne aap aayega.
  • Netflix ki "The Queen's Gambit" (2020) series ke baad lakhon naye log chess khelne lage. Online chess (Lichess, Chess.com) se aaj seekhna bahut aasaan hai.

1.1.5 Sawal 3: Ek game haar gaye

Ek game haar gaye. Sabse achha kya hai?

Jawab

✓ Analyse karo: galti kahan aur kyun hui

  • Haar tab hi faydemand hai jab us se seekho.

1.1.6 Game ke 3 hisse

  • Opening: pieces bahar laana (development), center, castling. Aksar pehli 10-15 chaal.
  • Middlegame: dono taraf castle ho chuke, queens board par. Plans, attack, tactics. Creativity yahan sabse zyada.
  • Endgame: bahut pieces trade ho chuke. King bahar aakar ladta hai (mate ka khatra kam), aur pawns (promotion) sabse important.
  • Example: Uhlmann vs Fischer (1970): Modern Benoni opening, Fischer ne middlegame mein tactic se pawn jeeta, phir endgame mein king active karke jeeta.

1.1.7 Sawal 4: Queens trade ho gayi, kuch hi pieces bache, kings center ki taraf…

Queens trade ho gayi, kuch hi pieces bache, kings center ki taraf aa rahe hain. Kaunsa phase?

Jawab

✓ Endgame

  • Kam material + active kings = endgame.

1.1.8 Sawal 5: Endgame mein king ka role?

Endgame mein king ka role?

Jawab

✓ Active hokar ladna

  • Mate ka khatra kam ho jaata hai, isliye king ek taakatwar piece ban jaata hai.

1.1.9 Concentric circles: is course ka seekhne ka model

  • Teen gol daayre socho, andar se bahar:
  • 1.
  • Andar: badi philosophies aur principles.
  • Jaise "pehle khud ko haar se bachao, phir attack karo" (development, center, king safety).
  • 2.
  • Beech: processes (calculation, forcing moves: checks, captures, threats) aur patterns (fork, pin, mate patterns).
  • 3.
  • Bahar: specific details aur exceptions (opening names, variations, theoretical endgames).
  • Opening, middlegame aur endgame teeno ke apne daayre hain.
  • Course ke end tak yeh daayre bade karte jaana hai.

1.1.10 Sawal 6: Concentric circles mein sabse andar kya hai?

Concentric circles mein sabse andar kya hai?

Jawab

✓ Badi philosophies aur principles

  • Pehle principles.
  • Details baad mein unhe bada karte hain.

1.1.11 Geometry ka jaadu: mate sab se upar

  • Pieces ki keemat (queen 9, rook 5, bishop/knight 3) ek guide hai, kanoon nahi.
  • Checkmate game khatam kar deta hai, isliye mate ke liye queen bhi de sakte ho.
  • Famous "Fox ka masterpiece" game mein White ne pehle queen (Qxg6!!), phir knight (Nxg6) di, aur bishop + rook se mate kiya.
  • Chalo ek chhota version khud karo.

1.1.12 Abhyaas: Queen sacrifice karke mate in 2!

Queen sacrifice karke mate in 2!

Jawab dekho

1. Qxe8+ Qxe8 2. Rxe8#

  • `1.Qxe8+!
  • Qxe8 2.Rxe8#`.
  • Queen (9 points) di, par game jeet liya.
  • Black king apne hi pawns se band hai (back-rank mate).

1.2

Chessboard ko jaano

Squares, files, ranks, center

Yaad rakho
  • Board 8×8 = 64 squares. Light on right: neeche right corner (h1) hamesha light.
  • Files = khadi lines a-h, ranks = aadi lines 1-8. Square ka naam = file + rank (e4).
  • Center = d4 e4 d5 e5. Center ke pieces zyada squares control karte hain.
  • White hamesha pehli chaal chalta hai.
  • Pieces ke letters: K king, Q queen, R rook, B bishop, N knight. Pawn ka koi letter nahi.
  • Setup: rooks corner, phir knights, bishops. Queen apne colour par (White queen d1, Black queen d8), king uske bagal mein.
  • Square colour: a1 dark. (file number + rank) even = dark, odd = light.

1.2.1 Board: 64 squares

  • Chessboard mein 8×8 = 64 squares hote hain: 32 light, 32 dark.
  • Golden rule: board aise rakho ki right side ke neeche wala corner light square ho.
  • ("Light on right")
  • White ke pieces neeche (rank 1-2) aur Black ke upar (rank 7-8) se shuru hote hain.
  • White hamesha pehli chaal chalta hai.

1.2.2 Files aur ranks

  • Khadi lines (upar-neeche) ko files kehte hain: a se h tak.
  • Aadi lines (left-right) ko ranks kehte hain: 1 se 8 tak.
  • Har square ka naam = file + rank.
  • Jaise peeli line e-file hai, aur us par ek square hai e4.

1.2.3 Center sabse important

  • Beech ke 4 squares d4 e4 d5 e5 ko center kehte hain.
  • Center mein baitha piece zyada squares control karta hai.
  • Isliye opening mein sab center ke liye ladte hain.
  • Diagonal = tirchhi line, jaise a1 se h8.

1.2.4 Sawal 1: Kaunsa square light hai?

Kaunsa square light hai?

Jawab

✓ h1

  • "Light on right": White ki taraf right corner h1 light hota hai.
  • a1 dark hai.

1.2.5 Sawal 2: e4 mein e kya batata hai?

e4 mein e kya batata hai?

Jawab

✓ File (khadi line)

  • Pehle letter = file (a-h), phir number = rank (1-8).

1.2.6 Pieces ke naam aur setup

  • K King, Q Queen, R Rook, B Bishop, N Knight (K pehle se king ke liye hai). Pawn ka koi letter nahi.
  • Neeche se: rank 1 par R N B Q K B N R, rank 2 par 8 pawns.
  • "Queen apne colour par": White queen light square d1, Black queen dark square d8.
  • Dono kings ek hi file (e) par aamne-saamne.

1.2.7 Sawal 3: Notation mein knight ka letter kya hai?

Notation mein knight ka letter kya hai?

Jawab

✓ N

  • K king ke liye hai, isliye knight = N.

1.2.8 Sawal 4: Is setup mein galti kya hai?

Is setup mein galti kya hai?

Jawab

✓ White king aur queen ki jagah ulti hai

  • Queen apne colour par: White queen d1 (light) par honi chahiye, king e1 par.

1.2.9 Diagonals

  • Tirchhi lines ko diagonal kehte hain.
  • Sabse lambi do: a1-h8 aur h1-a8 (8-8 squares).
  • Bishop aur queen inhi par chalte hain.
  • Ek diagonal ke saare squares ek hi colour ke hote hain.

1.2.10 Sawal 5: d5 square kis colour ka hai?

d5 square kis colour ka hai?

Jawab

✓ Light

  • d = 4, rank 5: 4+5 = 9 (odd) = light.
  • Yaad rakho: a1 (1+1=2, even) dark hai.

1.2.11 Sawal 6: g7 kis colour ka hai?

g7 kis colour ka hai?

Jawab

✓ Dark

  • g = 7, rank 7: 7+7 = 14 (even) = dark.

1.3

Pieces kaise chalte hain

King, queen, rook, bishop, knight, pawn

Yaad rakho
  • Rook seedha (5), bishop tirchha (3), queen dono (9), knight "L" shape (3), king 1 square, pawn aage 1 (pehli baar 2).
  • Sirf knight pieces ke upar se kood sakta hai.
  • Pawn seedha chalta hai par tirchha capture karta hai, aur kabhi peeche nahi jaata.
  • King attack wale square par kabhi nahi ja sakta.
  • Center mein pieces sabse taakatwar: knight center mein 8 squares, corner mein sirf 2.
  • Pawn aage koi ho to ruk jaata hai (blocked), par tirchha capture kar sakta hai.
  • Do kings kabhi bagal mein nahi aa sakte: beech mein kam se kam ek square.
  • White hamesha pehli chaal chalta hai.

1.3.1 Rook ♜

  • Rook seedha chalta hai: upar, neeche, left, right.
  • Jitne marzi squares, jab tak koi raste mein na aaye.
  • Value: 5 points.

1.3.2 Board par dekho: Rook d4 kahan-kahan ja sakta hai?

Rook d4 kahan-kahan ja sakta hai?

  • Rook d7 ke knight ko capture kar sakta hai, par uske aage nahi ja sakta.
  • Capture karne ke liye dushman ke square par jaate hain.

1.3.3 Bishop ♝

  • Bishop sirf diagonal (tirchha) chalta hai.
  • Light square wala bishop hamesha light squares par hi rahega.
  • Value: 3 points.

1.3.4 Board par dekho: Bishop c4 kahan ja sakta hai?

Bishop c4

  • Apna pawn b3 raasta rok raha hai.
  • f7 ka black pawn capture ho sakta hai.

1.3.5 Queen ♛

  • Queen = rook + bishop.
  • Seedha bhi, tirchha bhi.
  • Sabse taakatwar piece.
  • Value: 9 points.
  • Isko faltu mein mat khona!

1.3.6 Board par dekho: Queen d4 kahan ja sakta hai?

Queen d4

  • Center mein queen 27 squares tak control karti hai!

1.3.7 Knight ♞

  • Knight "L" shape mein chalta hai: 2 square ek taraf, phir 1 square side mein.
  • Knight hi akela piece hai jo doosre pieces ke upar se kood sakta hai.
  • Har chaal mein woh light se dark (ya dark se light) square par jaata hai.
  • Value: 3 points.

1.3.8 Board par dekho: Knight d4 kahan ja sakta hai?

Knight d4

  • Center mein knight 8 squares, corner mein sirf 2.
  • "Knight on the rim is dim": kinare par knight kamzor hota hai.

1.3.9 Board par dekho: Corner wala knight a1

Corner wala knight a1: kitne squares?

  • Sirf 2!
  • Isliye knights ko center ki taraf lao.

1.3.10 Pawn ♟

  • Pawn sirf aage chalta hai, ek square.
  • Pehli chaal mein 2 square bhi ja sakta hai.
  • Par capture tirchha karta hai (ek square aage diagonal).
  • Seedha aage koi ho to pawn ruk jaata hai.
  • Pawn kabhi peeche nahi jaata.
  • Value: 1 point.

1.3.11 Board par dekho: Pawn e2 kahan ja sakta hai?

Pawn e2 kahan ja sakta hai?

  • e3, e4 (pehli chaal) aur d3 par knight ko capture.

1.3.12 King ♚

  • King har taraf sirf 1 square chalta hai.
  • King ko kabhi aise square par nahi le ja sakte jahan dushman attack kar raha ho.
  • Yahan black rook poori 5th rank control kar raha hai.
  • King ki value infinite hai: king gaya to game gaya.

1.3.13 Board par dekho: King e4 kahan ja sakta hai?

King e4 kahan ja sakta hai?

  • d5, e5, f5 par rook ka attack hai, isliye king wahan nahi ja sakta.

1.3.14 Sawal 1: Kaunsa piece doosre pieces ke upar se kood sakta hai?

Kaunsa piece doosre pieces ke upar se kood sakta hai?

Jawab

✓ Knight

  • Sirf knight jump karta hai.

1.3.15 Sawal 2: Pawn capture kaise karta hai?

Pawn capture kaise karta hai?

Jawab

✓ Tirchha aage (diagonal)

  • Pawn seedha chalta hai par tirchha capture karta hai.

1.3.16 Board par dekho: Pawn e4 aage blocked hai

Pawn e4 aage blocked hai. Kahan ja sakta hai?

  • Seedha e5 blocked hai, par tirchha d5 ka knight capture ho sakta hai.

1.3.17 Board par dekho: Shuru ki position

Shuru ki position: knight g1 kahan ja sakta hai?

  • Knight pawns ke upar se kood ke f3 ya h3 ja sakta hai.
  • Isliye pehli chaal mein bhi knight chal sakta hai.

1.3.18 Board par dekho: Knight d4 apne pawns ke upar se koodta hai

Knight d4 apne pawns ke upar se koodta hai.

  • Apne pawns raasta nahi rokte, knight koodta hai.
  • c6 ka pawn capture ho sakta hai.

1.3.19 Board par dekho: Bheed wale board par rook b4

Bheed wale board par rook b4: kahan-kahan?

  • Apna pawn (b2, e4) raasta rokta hai.
  • Dushman (b6) ko capture karke wahin rukna padta hai.

1.3.20 Board par dekho: Kings aamne-saamne

Kings aamne-saamne: King d3 kahan ja sakta hai?

  • c4, d4, e4 black king ke bagal mein hain.
  • Do kings kabhi bagal mein nahi aa sakte.

1.4

Special moves

Castling, en passant, promotion

Yaad rakho
  • Castling: king 2 square rook ki taraf, rook doosri taraf. O-O kingside, O-O-O queenside.
  • Castling tab nahi: king/rook pehle chal chuke, beech mein piece, king check mein, ya king attacked square se guzre.
  • En passant: dushman pawn 2 square chal kar bagal mein aaye to turant agli chaal mein capture.
  • Promotion: aakhri rank par pawn queen/rook/bishop/knight banta hai. Kabhi knight (underpromotion) best hota hai.
  • Castling ki philosophy: pehle king safe karo, phir attack ("put yourself beyond defeat").
  • Queenside castling mein b1 (ya b8) attack mein ho tab bhi castle ho sakta hai: king us square se nahi guzarta.
  • En passant Black bhi kar sakta hai, aur promotion capture karke bhi hota hai.

1.4.1 Castling: king ki suraksha

  • Castling mein ek hi chaal mein king 2 square rook ki taraf jaata hai, aur rook king ke doosri taraf aa jaata hai.
  • Kingside: O-O (king g1, rook f1)
  • Queenside: O-O-O (king c1, rook d1)
  • Shart: king aur rook pehle kabhi na chale hon, beech mein koi piece na ho, king check mein na ho, aur king jis square se guzre ya pahunche woh attack mein na ho.

1.4.2 Abhyaas: Kingside castle karo (O-O)

Kingside castle karo (O-O). King ko g1 par tap karo.

Jawab dekho

1. O-O

  • King ab safe corner mein hai aur rook center ki taraf aa gaya.

1.4.3 Sawal 1: Kya White yahan kingside castle kar sakta hai?

Kya White yahan kingside castle kar sakta hai?

Jawab

✓ Nahi: f1 attack mein hai

  • King f1 se guzrega, aur c4 ka bishop f1 ko attack kar raha hai.
  • Isliye castling allowed nahi.

1.4.4 En passant

  • Agar dushman ka pawn 2 square chal kar tumhare pawn ke bilkul bagal mein aa jaaye, to tum use aise capture kar sakte ho jaise woh 1 hi square chala ho.
  • Ise en passant kehte hain.
  • Yeh sirf turant agli chaal mein hi ho sakta hai.
  • Yahan Black ne abhi d7-d5 khela.

1.4.5 Abhyaas: En passant karo

En passant karo: e5 pawn se d6 par capture.

Jawab dekho

1. exd6

  • Pawn d6 par gaya aur d5 ka black pawn board se hat gaya.

1.4.6 Promotion

  • Pawn jab aakhri rank (White ke liye 8th) par pahunchta hai, to woh queen, rook, bishop ya knight ban jaata hai.
  • Zyadatar queen banate hain.
  • Isliye endgame mein pawns bahut keemti ho jaate hain.

1.4.7 Abhyaas: Pawn ko queen banao

Pawn ko queen banao.

Jawab dekho

1. e8=Q

Ye bhi sahi: e8=R

  • Ab White ke paas queen hai, aur yeh jeetne wali position hai.

1.4.8 Abhyaas: Kabhi queen nahi, knight banana better hota hai!

Kabhi queen nahi, knight banana better hota hai! Sabse achhi chaal dhundo.

Jawab dekho

1. e8=N+ Ke5 2. Nxc7

  • e8=N+ check deta hai aur c7 ki queen par bhi attack karta hai (fork).
  • King hatega, phir knight queen le lega.
  • Ise underpromotion kehte hain.

1.4.9 Castling kyun?

  • Purani salah: "Pehle khud ko haar se bachao, phir attack karo." Castling se king center se hat kar pawns ke peeche safe ho jaata hai, aur rook game mein aa jaata hai.
  • Isliye opening mein jaldi castle karo.

1.4.10 Abhyaas: Kya yahan queenside castle ho sakta hai?

Kya yahan queenside castle ho sakta hai? b1 attack mein hai! Agar ho sakta hai, to karo.

Jawab dekho

1. O-O-O

  • Haan!
  • King e1, d1, c1 ko chhoota hai, b1 ko nahi.
  • Sirf rook b1 se guzarta hai, aur rook ke liye attack se farak nahi padta.

1.4.11 Sawal 2: Kya White kingside castle kar sakta hai?

Kya White kingside castle kar sakta hai?

Jawab

✓ Nahi: king g1 par check mein aa jaayega

  • Black rook g8 poori g-file control karta hai.
  • Castling se check mein jaana allowed nahi.

1.4.12 Sawal 3: Kya White kingside castle kar sakta hai?

Kya White kingside castle kar sakta hai?

Jawab

✓ Nahi: beech mein knight hai

  • King aur rook ke beech saare squares khaali hone chahiye.
  • Pehle Ng1 ko develop karo.

1.4.13 Sawal 4: White king check mein hai

White king check mein hai. Kya castle karke check se bach sakta hai?

Jawab

✓ Nahi, check mein castling allowed nahi

  • Check se bachne ke liye castling nahi kar sakte.

1.4.14 Sawal 5: King ne pehle ek chaal chali, phir wapas e1 aa gaya

King ne pehle ek chaal chali, phir wapas e1 aa gaya. Ab castling?

Jawab

✓ Kabhi nahi ho sakti

  • King ya woh rook ek baar bhi chal gaya to us taraf castling hamesha ke liye khatam.

1.4.15 Abhyaas: Black ki chaal

Black ki chaal: en passant karo!

Jawab dekho

1… exd3

  • White pawn d2-d4 do square chala aur e4 pawn ke bagal mein aaya.
  • Black ne turant exd3 se capture kiya.

1.4.16 Abhyaas: Capture karke promotion!

Capture karke promotion! Rook lo aur queen banao.

Jawab dekho

1. bxa8=Q+

  • Pawn ne tirchha a8 ka rook capture kiya aur saath mein queen ban gaya, check ke saath.

1.5

Check, checkmate, stalemate

Game kaise jeette hain

Yaad rakho
  • Check se bachne ke 3 tareeke: king hatao, block karo, attacker ko capture karo.
  • Checkmate = check + bachne ka koi raasta nahi = jeet.
  • Stalemate = check nahi par koi legal chaal nahi = draw. Jeette waqt iska dhyan rakho!
  • Back-rank mate: king apne hi pawns ke peeche band.
  • Check har piece de sakta hai: pawn tirchha, knight L se (block nahi ho sakta), rook/bishop/queen line se.
  • Double check: sirf king hil kar bachta hai.
  • Discovered check: ek piece hata, peeche wale piece ka check khul gaya.
Is lesson ke topics
  1. 1.5.1 Check
  2. 1.5.2 Checkmate = jeet
  3. 1.5.3 Abhyaas: Mate in 1
  4. 1.5.4 Abhyaas: Mate in 1
  5. 1.5.5 Stalemate = draw!
  6. 1.5.6 Sawal 1: Black ki chaal hai
  7. 1.5.7 Abhyaas: Mate karo, stalemate nahi!
  8. 1.5.8 Sawal 2: Check se bachne ka kaunsa tareeka galat hai?
  9. 1.5.9 Sawal 3: Black king ko kaun check de raha hai?
  10. 1.5.10 Abhyaas: Check se bacho
  11. 1.5.11 Abhyaas: Rook ka check!
  12. 1.5.12 Abhyaas: Check! Na capture, na block
  13. 1.5.13 Sawal 4: Double check (do pieces ek saath check) mein kya kar sakte ho?
  14. 1.5.14 Abhyaas: Discovered check
  15. 1.5.15 Sawal 5: Kya do kings bagal-bagal (jaise e4 aur e5) aa sakte hain?

1.5.1 Check

  • Jab king par attack ho to use check kehte hain.
  • Check se turant bachna zaroori hai. 3 tareeke:
    • King ko hatao safe square par
    • Beech mein piece rakho (block)
    • Attack karne wale piece ko capture karo

1.5.2 Checkmate = jeet

  • Agar king check mein hai aur bachne ka koi tareeka nahi, to yeh checkmate hai.
  • Game khatam, jisne mate diya woh jeeta.
  • Yahan Black king ke apne pawns hi uska raasta rok rahe hain.
  • Ise back-rank mate kehte hain.

1.5.3 Abhyaas: Mate in 1

Mate in 1: ek chaal mein checkmate karo!

Jawab dekho

1. Ra8#

  • Ra8#: back-rank mate.
  • King ke paas koi square nahi.

1.5.4 Abhyaas: Mate in 1

Mate in 1: queen aur king ki team-work.

Jawab dekho

1. Qb8#

  • King escape squares band karta hai, queen 8th rank par check deti hai: Qb8#.

1.5.5 Stalemate = draw!

  • Agar jiski chaal hai uska king check mein nahi, par usse koi bhi legal chaal nahi hai, to yeh stalemate hai.
  • Stalemate = draw.
  • Yahan Black ki chaal hai: king h8 hilega to attack mein aayega, aur koi aur piece nahi.
  • Jeeta hua game draw ho gaya!
  • Jeetne wale ko is se bachna hai.

1.5.6 Sawal 1: Black ki chaal hai

Black ki chaal hai. Yeh kya hai?

Jawab

✓ Stalemate

  • Black king check mein nahi hai par uski har chaal attack mein jaati hai.
  • Koi aur piece nahi, to stalemate (draw).

1.5.7 Abhyaas: Mate karo, stalemate nahi!

Mate karo, stalemate nahi! Dhyan se.

Jawab dekho

1. Qf8#

  • Qf8# check deta hai.
  • Agar Qf7 khelte to Black ke paas koi chaal na hoti aur check bhi na hota: stalemate.

1.5.8 Sawal 2: Check se bachne ka kaunsa tareeka galat hai?

Check se bachne ka kaunsa tareeka galat hai?

Jawab

✓ Apni koi bhi doosri chaal chalna

  • Check mein ho to sirf woh chaal chal sakte ho jo check hataye.

1.5.9 Sawal 3: Black king ko kaun check de raha hai?

Black king ko kaun check de raha hai?

Jawab

✓ Knight

  • Knight d6 se e8 par L-shape.
  • Knight ka check block nahi ho sakta: ya king hatao ya knight capture karo.

1.5.10 Abhyaas: Check se bacho

Check se bacho: checking piece ko capture karo.

Jawab dekho

1. Kxe2

  • Queen protected nahi thi, isliye king ne khud capture kar liya.
  • Protected hoti to king capture nahi kar sakta.

1.5.11 Abhyaas: Rook ka check!

Rook ka check! Beech mein piece rakh kar (block) bachao.

Jawab dekho

1. Nf1

  • Nf1 check block karta hai, aur king knight ko protect karta hai.

1.5.12 Abhyaas: Check! Na capture, na block

Check! Na capture, na block. King ko safe square par le jao.

Jawab dekho

1. Kd2

Ye bhi sahi: Kd1 Kf1 Kf2

  • Rook ki e-file chhodo: d1, d2, f1, f2 sab safe hain.

1.5.13 Sawal 4: Double check (do pieces ek saath check) mein kya kar sakte ho?

Double check (do pieces ek saath check) mein kya kar sakte ho?

Jawab

✓ Sirf king ko hilao

  • Ek chaal se do checks block ya capture nahi ho sakte.
  • King ko hilna hi padega.

1.5.14 Abhyaas: Discovered check

Discovered check: bishop hatao, rook ka check khulega. Saath mein queen jeeto!

Jawab dekho

1. Bxa8+

  • Bishop ne queen li aur e1 rook ka check khul gaya.
  • Black pehle check ka jawab dega, queen wapas nahi le sakta.

1.5.15 Sawal 5: Kya do kings bagal-bagal (jaise e4 aur e5) aa sakte hain?

Kya do kings bagal-bagal (jaise e4 aur e5) aa sakte hain?

Jawab

✓ Nahi, kabhi nahi

  • King ek doosre ko check de rahe honge, jo illegal hai.

1.6

Jeet aur draw ke tareeke

Checkmate, resign, time; perpetual, stalemate, repetition, 50-move, agreement

Yaad rakho
  • Draw ke 5 tareeke: stalemate, 3-fold repetition, 50-move rule, insufficient material, agreement.
  • K+N vs K aur K+B vs K = draw (mate namumkin).
  • K+R vs K aur K+Q vs K = jeet.
  • Haarti position mein repetition / perpetual check se draw bacha sakte ho.
  • Jeet: checkmate, opponent resign kare, ya opponent ka time khatam (agar tumhare paas mate ka material ho).
  • Draw: stalemate, insufficient material, 3-fold repetition, 50-move rule, perpetual check, mutual agreement.
  • Haar rahe ho to perpetual check ya stalemate se draw bachao.
Is lesson ke topics
  1. 1.6.1 Jeetne ke 3 tareeke
  2. 1.6.2 Draw ke 5 tareeke
  3. 1.6.3 Sawal 1: King + ek Knight vs akela King
  4. 1.6.4 Sawal 2: King + Rook vs akela King?
  5. 1.6.5 Sawal 3: Dono players ek hi chaal baar-baar repeat karte hain aur position…
  6. 1.6.6 Sawal 4: Opponent ka time khatam ho gaya, par tumhare paas sirf king hai
  7. 1.6.7 Abhyaas: Tum Black ho aur bahut peeche ho
  8. 1.6.8 Sawal 5: King + Bishop vs King + Bishop (dono bishops same colour)
  9. 1.6.9 Sawal 6: 50 chaal (dono taraf) tak na koi pawn chala, na capture hua
  10. 1.6.10 Sawal 7: Dono players game ke beech draw par raazi ho gaye
  11. 1.6.11 Sawal 8: Tum jeet rahe ho
  12. 1.6.12 Diagram: Stalemate
  13. 1.6.13 Diagram: Insufficient material

1.6.1 Jeetne ke 3 tareeke

  • Checkmate: game wahin khatam.
  • Resign: opponent haar maan le (haari position mein aksar log resign karte hain).
  • Time: clock wale game mein opponent ka time khatam ho jaaye to tum jeete. Par agar tumhare paas mate karne ka material hi nahi (jaise sirf king), to draw.

1.6.2 Draw ke 5 tareeke

  • Stalemate: chaal hai, par koi legal move nahi aur check bhi nahi.
  • 3-fold repetition: same position 3 baar aaye (same player ki chaal ke saath).
  • 50-move rule: 50 chaalein (dono taraf) bina pawn move ya capture ke.
  • Insufficient material: mate karna namumkin. Jaise King vs King, King+Bishop vs King, King+Knight vs King.
  • Agreement: dono players draw maan lein.

1.6.3 Sawal 1: King + ek Knight vs akela King

King + ek Knight vs akela King: kya hoga?

Jawab

✓ Draw: mate ke liye material kam hai

  • Akele knight ya bishop se mate nahi diya ja sakta.

1.6.4 Sawal 2: King + Rook vs akela King?

King + Rook vs akela King?

Jawab

✓ Jeet: rook se mate diya ja sakta hai

  • Rook (ya queen) ke saath mate force kar sakte hain.
  • Yeh technique Level 2 mein seekhoge.

1.6.5 Sawal 3: Dono players ek hi chaal baar-baar repeat karte hain aur position…

Dono players ek hi chaal baar-baar repeat karte hain aur position 3 baar same hoti hai. Kya hoga?

Jawab

✓ Draw (3-fold repetition)

  • 3 baar same position = draw claim kar sakte hain.
  • Isko "perpetual check" mein bhi dekhoge.

1.6.6 Sawal 4: Opponent ka time khatam ho gaya, par tumhare paas sirf king hai

Opponent ka time khatam ho gaya, par tumhare paas sirf king hai. Result?

Jawab

✓ Draw

  • Akela king kabhi mate nahi kar sakta, isliye time par bhi draw.

1.6.7 Abhyaas: Tum Black ho aur bahut peeche ho

Tum Black ho aur bahut peeche ho. Perpetual check se draw bachao!

Jawab dekho

1… Qf2+ 2. Kh1 Qf1+ 3. Kh2 Qf2+

  • Qf2+ Kh1 Qf1+ Kh2 Qf2+...
  • White king bach nahi sakta, checks khatam nahi honge = draw.

1.6.8 Sawal 5: King + Bishop vs King + Bishop (dono bishops same colour)

King + Bishop vs King + Bishop (dono bishops same colour). Result?

Jawab

✓ Draw (insufficient material)

  • Koi bhi mate force nahi kar sakta.

1.6.9 Sawal 6: 50 chaal (dono taraf) tak na koi pawn chala, na capture hua

50 chaal (dono taraf) tak na koi pawn chala, na capture hua. Kya hota hai?

Jawab

✓ Player draw claim kar sakta hai

  • Yeh 50-move rule hai.

1.6.10 Sawal 7: Dono players game ke beech draw par raazi ho gaye

Dono players game ke beech draw par raazi ho gaye. Allowed?

Jawab

✓ Haan, mutual agreement se draw

  • Draw offer apni chaal chalne ke baad karo, opponent maane to draw.

1.6.11 Sawal 8: Tum jeet rahe ho

Tum jeet rahe ho. Stalemate se kaise bacho?

Jawab

✓ Har chaal par dekho ki opponent ke paas koi legal chaal bachi hai ya nahi

  • Akele king ko hamesha kam se kam ek square ya chaal chhodo, jab tak mate na de sako.

1.7

Pieces ki keemat aur trades

Kab lena hai, kab nahi

Yaad rakho
  • Pawn 1, knight 3, bishop 3, rook 5, queen 9, king anmol.
  • Trade se pehle points jodo: 3 dekar 5 mila = exchange jeeta.
  • Har chaal mein dekho: koi piece hanging (bina protection) to nahi?
  • Capture se pehle attackers aur defenders gino.
  • Keemat ek guide hai: bishop aksar knight se thoda behtar (~3.25), khaas kar open board par.
  • Algebraic symbols: K Q R B N; capture x, check +, mate #.
Is lesson ke topics
  1. 1.7.1 Point system
  2. 1.7.2 Sawal 1: Tumhara knight dekar dushman ka rook mile
  3. 1.7.3 Sawal 2: Queen (9) ke badle do rooks (5+5)
  4. 1.7.4 Abhyaas: Koi piece free mein mil raha hai
  5. 1.7.5 Abhyaas: Black ki queen ne galti ki
  6. 1.7.6 Sawal 3: Yahan White Nxe5 khel sakta hai

  8. 1.7.8 Sawal 5: Do minor pieces (3+3) ke badle ek rook (5) aur ek pawn (1)
  9. 1.7.9 Diagram: Exchange

1.7.1 Point system

  • Pawn = 1
  • Knight = 3
  • Bishop = 3 (thoda zyada jab dono bishops ho)
  • Rook = 5
  • Queen = 9
  • King = anmol
  • Trade karte waqt points jodo.
  • Bishop (3) dekar rook (5) mila to tumne "exchange" jeeta.
  • Yeh sirf guide hai: position zyada important hai, par shuru mein yeh bahut kaam aata hai.

1.7.2 Sawal 1: Tumhara knight dekar dushman ka rook mile

Tumhara knight dekar dushman ka rook mile. Achha trade?

Jawab

✓ Haan: 3 dekar 5 mile

  • +2 points ka fayda.

Queen (9) ke badle do rooks (5+5). Points mein kaun aage?

Jawab

✓ Do rooks wala

  • 10 vs 9: do rooks thode zyada.
  • Real game mein dono kaafi barabar hote hain.

1.7.4 Abhyaas: Koi piece free mein mil raha hai

Koi piece free mein mil raha hai. Lelo!

Jawab dekho

1. Rxd5

  • Queen ko kisi ne protect nahi kiya tha.
  • Hamesha dekho: kya koi piece bina protection ke hai?
  • ("hanging piece")

Black ki queen ne galti ki. Saza do!

Jawab dekho

1. Nxh4

  • Nxh4: knight ne queen le li. 9 points free!

1.7.6 Sawal 3: Yahan White Nxe5 khel sakta hai

Yahan White Nxe5 khel sakta hai. Kya yeh achha hai?

Jawab

✓ Nahi: Nc6 pawn ko protect kar raha hai

  • Nxe5 Nxe5 ke baad White ne knight (3) diya aur pawn (1) liya.
  • Pehle attackers aur defenders gino.

Bishop aur knight dono 3. Open board (kam pawns) par aksar kaun behtar?

Jawab

✓ Bishop

  • Bishop door tak chalta hai.
  • Band (closed) position mein knight behtar ho sakta hai.

1.7.8 Sawal 5: Do minor pieces (3+3) ke badle ek rook (5) aur ek pawn (1)

Do minor pieces (3+3) ke badle ek rook (5) aur ek pawn (1). Kaun aage?

1.8

Notation: moves likhna aur padhna

Chess ki bhasha

Yaad rakho
  • Chaal = piece letter + square: Nf3, Bc4. Pawn ka letter nahi: e4.
  • x capture, + check, # mate, O-O / O-O-O castling, e8=Q promotion.
  • ! achhi, !! shandaar, ? galti, ?? blunder, !? interesting, ?! doubtful.
  • Fool's mate seekh: opening mein f aur g pawns faltu mat chalao.
  • Descriptive notation (purani): P-K4 = e4. Har square ke do naam (White aur Black ki taraf se).
  • FEN: ek line mein poori position. Number = khaali squares, w/b = kiski chaal, KQkq = castling.
Is lesson ke topics
  1. 1.8.1 Algebraic notation
  2. 1.8.2 Sawal 1: Bxf7+ ka matlab?
  3. 1.8.3 Sawal 2: O-O-O kya hai?
  4. 1.8.4 Sawal 3: exd5 mein kaunsa piece chala?
  5. 1.8.5 Abhyaas: Notation se chaal chalo
  6. 1.8.6 Notation padho: Italian Game
  7. 1.8.7 Descriptive notation (purani)
  8. 1.8.8 Sawal 4: Descriptive N-KB3 (White) ka algebraic?
  9. 1.8.9 FEN: position ki ek line
  10. 1.8.10 Sawal 5: FEN mein 8 ka matlab?
  11. 1.8.11 Sawal 6: FEN ke end mein ..

1.8.1 Algebraic notation

  • Har chaal = piece ka letter + square.
  • K = King, Q = Queen, R = Rook, B = Bishop, N = Knight
  • Pawn ka koi letter nahi: e4 matlab pawn e4 par gaya
  • x = capture: Nxe5 (knight ne e5 par capture kiya), exd5 (e-pawn ne d5 par)
  • + = check, # = checkmate
  • O-O = kingside castle, O-O-O = queenside
  • e8=Q = promotion
  • Annotation: ! achhi chaal, !! shandaar, ? galti, ?? blunder, !? interesting, ?! doubtful.

1.8.2 Sawal 1: Bxf7+ ka matlab?

Bxf7+ ka matlab?

Jawab

✓ Bishop ne f7 par capture kiya aur check diya

  • B = bishop, x = capture, + = check.

1.8.3 Sawal 2: O-O-O kya hai?

O-O-O kya hai?

Jawab

✓ Queenside castle

  • Teen O = lamba castle (queen ki taraf).

1.8.4 Sawal 3: exd5 mein kaunsa piece chala?

exd5 mein kaunsa piece chala?

Jawab

✓ e-file ka pawn

  • Pawn capture mein uski file likhte hain: e-pawn ne d5 par capture kiya.

1.8.5 Abhyaas: Notation se chaal chalo

Notation se chaal chalo: Nf3

Jawab dekho

1. Nf3

  • Knight g1 se f3 par.
  • Bahut achhi opening chaal hai.

1.8.6 Notation padho: Italian Game

  • Har chaal ko notation se padho aur board par dekho.

1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bc4 Bc5 4. O-O Nf6 5. d3 O-O

  • 1.e4: pawn e2 se e4 (pawn ka letter nahi).
  • 2.Nf3: knight f3 par.
  • 3.Bc4: bishop c4 par.
  • 4.O-O: kingside castling.
  • 5...O-O: Black ne bhi castle kiya. Ab dono kings safe.

1.8.7 Descriptive notation (purani)

  • Purani kitabon aur "The Queen's Gambit" series mein yeh notation dikhti hai.
  • Squares file ke piece ke naam se: e-file = K (king) file, f-file = KB (king bishop) file...
  • P-K4 = pawn king file ke 4th square par = 1.e4
  • N-KB3 = Nf3
  • Rank apni taraf se ginte hain, isliye har square ke do naam (White ke liye K4, Black ke liye K5 = e4).
  • Aaj sab algebraic use karte hain: chhota aur saaf.

1.8.8 Sawal 4: Descriptive N-KB3 (White) ka algebraic?

Descriptive N-KB3 (White) ka algebraic?

Jawab

✓ Nf3

  • KB file = f-file, White ki taraf se 3rd rank = f3.

1.8.9 FEN: position ki ek line

  • FEN (Forsyth-Edwards Notation) ek line mein poori position likhta hai.
  • Shuru ki position:
  • rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 0 1
  • Rank 8 se rank 1 tak, / se alag.
  • Bade letters White, chhote Black. Number = itne khaali squares.
  • w = White ki chaal. KQkq = castling ke haq. - = en passant square nahi. Last do numbers: 50-move counter aur chaal number.

1.8.10 Sawal 5: FEN mein 8 ka matlab?

FEN mein 8 ka matlab?

Jawab

✓ Poori rank khaali (8 khaali squares)

  • Number hamesha khaali squares ki ginti hai.

1.8.11 Sawal 6: FEN ke end mein ..

FEN ke end mein ... b KQkq - 0 1: b ka matlab?

Jawab

✓ Black ki chaal

  • w = White to move, b = Black to move.

1.9

Tournament rules, clock aur ratings

Touch-move, ek haath, clock, scoresheet, etiquette, ratings

Yaad rakho
  • Touch-move: chhua piece chalana padega. Theek karna ho to "adjust" / "J'adoube".
  • Clock usi haath se dabao jisse chaal chali. Phone bajna = aksar haar.
  • Draw offer apni chaal ke baad, clock se pehle.
  • Titles: CM 2200, FM 2300, IM 2400 + norms, GM 2500 + 3 norms.
  • Ek haath se chaal, usi haath se clock. Castling mein pehle king 2 square, phir rook.
  • Opponent ka piece chhua to (legal ho to) use capture karna padega.
  • Pawn 8th rank par pahunche to promote karna zaroori (queen, rook, bishop ya knight).
  • Mobile phone tournament hall mein nahi. Opponent ko disturb mat karo. Scoresheet saaf likho. FIDE Handbook mein saare rules.

1.9.1 Over-the-board rules

  • Touch-move: jo piece chhua, wahi chalana padega. Apna piece theek karna ho to pehle "adjust" (ya "J'adoube") bolo.
  • Piece chhod diya = chaal poori.
  • Clock usi haath se dabao jisse chaal chali.
  • Illegal move: rapid/blitz mein opponent ko extra time; doosri illegal move par haar (FIDE rules ke hisaab se).
  • Classical mein notation likhna zaroori (scoresheet).
  • Phone pass mein ho aur baj jaaye = aksar haar.
  • Draw offer apni chaal chalne ke baad, clock dabane se pehle.
  • Rating: Elo system.
  • Jeet se rating badhti hai, haar se ghatti.
  • Stronger player ko harane par zyada points.
  • FIDE titles: CM (2200), FM (2300), IM (2400 + norms), GM (2500 + 3 GM norms).
  • Women: WCM, WFM, WIM, WGM.

Level 2

Pehli jeet: mate, safety aur opening

Basic mates, hanging pieces, samajhdaari se capture, opening principles, shuruaati traps, sochne ka tareeka

  • Ab pehle games jeetna seekhenge: akele king ko mate karna, apne pieces bachana, sahi capture chunna, aur opening mein galtiyon (traps) se bachna.
2.1

Queen se mate (K+Q vs K)

Box method

Yaad rakho
  • Queen ko dushman king se knight ki doori par rakho: box chhota karte jao.
  • King edge par aa jaaye to apna king paas lao.
  • Mate queen + king ki team se hota hai.
  • Har chaal ke baad check karo: Black ke paas chaal bachi hai? Warna stalemate.
Is lesson ke topics
  1. 2.1.1 Box method
  2. 2.1.2 Final picture
  3. 2.1.3 Khud khelo: Checkmate karo

2.1.1 Box method

  • Queen + King se mate dene ke steps:
    • Queen ko knight ki doori par rakho dushman king se. Isse king ek "box" mein band hota hai.
    • Box ko chhota karte jao, jab tak king kinare (edge) par na aa jaaye.
    • Ab apne king ko paas lao.
    • Queen se mate do, king ki help se.
  • Khatra: stalemate!
  • Har chaal ke baad dekho ki Black ke paas koi chaal bachi hai.

2.1.2 Final picture

  • Aisi position mein mate hota hai: queen king ke saamne, aur apna king queen ko protect kar raha hai.
  • Ya queen poori edge rank par check de jabki king saamne khada ho.

2.1.3 Khud khelo: Checkmate karo

Ab tum karo: Black king ko 20 chaal ke andar mate do.

  • Queen ko king ke paas mat le jao jahan woh protect na ho!

Course mein ye position khelo ›

2.2

Rook se mate (K+R vs K)

Opposition aur rook ki deewar

Yaad rakho
  • Rook ek deewar banata hai: king ko ek taraf band karo.
  • Apne king ko saamne lao (beech mein ek square) = opposition.
  • Kings aamne-saamne hon tab rook se check: king peeche jaata hai.
  • Rook ko dushman king se door rakho taaki woh capture na ho.
Is lesson ke topics
  1. 2.2.1 Rook ki deewar
  2. 2.2.2 Mate ki picture
  3. 2.2.3 Abhyaas: Mate in 1
  4. 2.2.4 Khud khelo: Checkmate karo

2.2.1 Rook ki deewar

  • Rook ek deewar banata hai jo king ko ek taraf band rakhti hai.
  • Rook se king ko ek rank/file mein band karo.
  • Apne king ko dushman king ke saamne lao (beech mein ek square) = opposition.
  • Jab kings aamne-saamne hon, rook se check do: king peeche jaayega.
  • Aise edge tak dhakelo, phir edge par check = mate.
  • Rook ko dushman king se door rakho taaki woh use pakad na le.

2.2.2 Mate ki picture

  • Kings aamne-saamne.
  • Ab Ra8#: rook poori 8th rank par check deta hai, aur apna king d7, e7, f7 band karta hai.

Mate in 1

Jawab dekho

1. Ra8#

Ab poora karo: 30 chaal mein rook se mate.

2.3

Do rooks aur Queen+Rook se mate

Ladder (seedhi) mate

Yaad rakho
  • Do rooks seedhi ki tarah: ek rank band, doosra agli rank par check.
  • King ki zaroorat nahi.
  • Dushman king rook ke paas aaye to rook ko doosre kinare le jao.
  • King do rooks ke beech fansa ho to ghabrao mat: ek rook ko doosri taraf le jao, taaki dono rooks ek hi side se seedhi banaayein.
  • Queen + rook bhi seedhi bana sakte hain: ek rank rokta hai, doosra check deta hai.

  1. 2.3.1 Ladder mate
  2. 2.3.2 Abhyaas: Mate in 2
  3. 2.3.3 Khud khelo: Checkmate karo
  4. 2.3.4 King rooks ke beech ho to?
  5. 2.3.5 Khud khelo: Checkmate karo
  6. 2.3.6 Queen + Rook: aur bhi tez
  7. 2.3.7 Abhyaas: Rook 7th rank rok raha hai
  8. 2.3.8 Khud khelo: Checkmate karo

2.3.1 Ladder mate

  • Do rooks seedhi ki tarah chalte hain: ek rook ek rank band karta hai, doosra agli rank par check deta hai.
  • Phir pehla aage badhta hai.
  • King ki zaroorat nahi!
  • Bas dhyan rahe ki king rooks ke paas aa kar unhe capture na kar le: tab rook ko door (doosre kinare) le jao.

2.3.2 Abhyaas: Mate in 2

Mate in 2: seedhi chalo.

Jawab dekho

1. Ra7 Kh8 2. Rb8#

  • Ra7 se 7th rank band, phir Rb8#.

2.3.3 Khud khelo: Checkmate karo

Do rooks se 12 chaal mein mate karo.

Course mein ye position khelo ›

2.3.4 King rooks ke beech ho to?

  • Kabhi dushman king dono rooks ke beech hota hai (ek rook upar ki rank band karta hai, doosra neeche ki).
  • Ghabrao mat:
    • Pehle socho king ko kis kinare dhakelna hai (jo zyada paas hai).
    • Jo rook galat taraf hai, use file ke bilkul kinare se ghuma kar doosri taraf lao, king se door rakhte hue.
    • Ab dono rooks ek hi side se seedhi (ladder) chalo: ek rank band, doosra agli rank par check.

2.3.5 Khud khelo: Checkmate karo

King rooks ke beech hai. Do rooks se 12 chaal mein mate karo.

2.3.6 Queen + Rook: aur bhi tez

  • Queen aur rook bhi seedhi (ladder) banate hain: ek piece king ko ek rank par rokta hai, doosra agli rank par check deta hai.
  • Bas dhyan rahe ki king tumhare piece ke bagal mein aakar use capture na kare: aise mein piece ko door wale side par le jao.

2.4

Hanging pieces aur safety

Attackers vs defenders

Yaad rakho
  • Beginners zyada games pieces free mein dene se haarte hain.
  • Har chaal se pehle: koi piece bina protection? Opponent ki pichli chaal ne kya attack kiya?
  • Attackers > defenders = piece khatre mein.
  • Opponent ka hanging piece dikhe to turant saza do.
  • "Loose pieces drop off": bina protection ke piece hi tactics ka nishaana bante hain.
  • Opponent ke loose pieces dhundo, apne loose pieces bachao.

    • Kya meri chaal ke baad koi piece bina protection ke reh jaayega?
    • Opponent ki pichli chaal ne kya attack kiya?
    • Kisi square par attackers gino aur defenders gino. Attackers zyada = piece khatre mein.

  • Tactics aksar wahin se shuru hoti hain.

2.5

Samajhdaari se capture

Attackers vs defenders ginna, sahi piece se capture

Yaad rakho
  • Capture se pehle gino: kitne attackers, kitne defenders.
  • Attackers zyada = capture aksar sahi. Barabar ya kam = soch ke.
  • Sabse sasta piece pehle capture kare (pawn se, queen se nahi).
  • Defender ko hata do (capture ya bhaga do), phir piece jeeto.
Is lesson ke topics
  1. 2.5.1 Capture karne se pehle gino
  2. 2.5.2 Abhyaas: Black knight d5 par hai
  3. 2.5.3 Abhyaas: d5 pawn: 2 attackers vs 1 defender
  4. 2.5.4 Sawal 1: Ek pawn par tumhare 2 attackers, opponent ke 3 defenders
  5. 2.5.5 Defender hatao

2.5.1 Capture karne se pehle gino

  • Har capture ke baad recapture hoga.
  • Isliye:
  • 1.
  • Attackers gino (tumhare kitne pieces us square ko attack karte hain).
  • 2.
  • Defenders gino (opponent ke kitne pieces bachate hain).
  • 3.
  • Attackers zyada hon to aksar capture achha hai, par sasta piece pehle use karo.
  • 4.
  • Points jodo: pawn ke badle knight de diya to nuksaan.

2.5.2 Abhyaas: Black knight d5 par hai

Black knight d5 par hai. Kis piece se capture karoge?

Jawab dekho

1. exd5

  • Pawn (1) se knight (3) lo.
  • cxd5 se pawn wapas jaayega, phir bhi tum 2 point aage.
  • Qxd5?? par cxd5 aur queen gayi!

2.5.3 Abhyaas: d5 pawn: 2 attackers vs 1 defender

d5 pawn: 2 attackers vs 1 defender. Pawn jeeto.

Jawab dekho

1. Nxd5 Nxd5 2. Bxd5

  • Nxd5 Nxd5 Bxd5: do attackers, ek defender, isliye aakhri capture tumhara.
  • Ek pawn aage.

2.5.4 Sawal 1: Ek pawn par tumhare 2 attackers, opponent ke 3 defenders

Ek pawn par tumhare 2 attackers, opponent ke 3 defenders. Capture karoge?

Jawab

✓ Aam taur par nahi

  • Defenders zyada hain: aakhri capture opponent ka hoga, tum material khoge.

2.5.5 Defender hatao

  • Kabhi piece protected hota hai, par uska defender khud kamzor hai.
  • Pehle defender ko capture karo ya bhagao, phir piece free ho jaata hai.
  • (Is idea ko aage tactics mein "removing the defender" kahenge.)

2.6

Opening ke 10 principles

Pehli 10-12 chaalein kaise khelein

Yaad rakho
  • Center lo (e4/d4), knights aur bishops develop karo, jaldi castle.
  • Ek piece baar-baar mat chalao, queen jaldi mat nikaalo.
  • Rooks connect karke open files par lao.
  • f7/f2 sabse kamzor square: Scholar's mate se bacho (...g6 ya ...Qe7).
  • Philosophy: pehle khud ko haar se bachao (development, center, castle), phir attack.
  • Opening mein lalach mat karo: pawn ke liye development aur king safety mat khoo.
  • Morphy jaise masters ne tez development aur jaldi castling se hi jeeta.
Is lesson ke topics
  1. 2.6.1 Opening principles
  2. 2.6.2 Sawal 1: Start position mein sabse achhi chaal kaunsi?
  3. 2.6.3 Abhyaas: White ki chaal
  4. 2.6.4 Masters se sabak
  5. 2.6.5 Sawal 2: Opening mein ek free pawn mil raha hai, par lene ke liye queen ko…
  6. 2.6.6 Sawal 3: Kaunsa principle sahi nahi?
  7. 2.6.7 Abhyaas: White ki queen jaldi aa gayi

2.6.1 Opening principles

  • Center lo: e4, d4 (ya e5, d5) pawns se.
  • Pieces develop karo: knights aur bishops ko pehle bahar lao. Knights pehle, bishops baad mein.
  • Jaldi castle karo (pehli 10 chaal mein).
  • Ek piece ko baar-baar mat chalao bina wajah.
  • Queen ko jaldi mat nikaalo: chhote pieces use bhaga dete hain aur tum time khote ho.
  • Rooks ko connect karo aur open files par lao.
  • Faltu pawn moves (a4, h4) mat karo shuru mein.
  • Pawn ke liye development mat chhodo.

2.6.2 Sawal 1: Start position mein sabse achhi chaal kaunsi?

Start position mein sabse achhi chaal kaunsi?

Jawab

✓ Nf3

  • Nf3 center (e5, d4) control karta hai aur castling ki taiyaari.

White ki chaal. Black ne galti ki: Scholar's mate do!

2.6.4 Masters se sabak

  • Development: Morphy vs Carpentier (1849): Morphy ne saare pieces jaldi bahar nikaale, opponent pieces ghar par baithe reh gaye.
  • Center: Greco vs NN: center ke pawns aur pieces se attack ke raaste khulte hain.
  • Jaldi castle: Morphy vs Schrufer: king center mein reh gaya to open files par mar gaya.
  • Lalach mat karo: opening mein ek pawn ke liye development aur king safety khona aksar haar hai.
  • Queen jaldi mat nikalo: chhote pieces se attack hokar woh time (tempo) khoti hai.

2.6.5 Sawal 2: Opening mein ek free pawn mil raha hai, par lene ke liye queen ko…

Opening mein ek free pawn mil raha hai, par lene ke liye queen ko 3 chaal chalni padegi aur king center mein rahega. Kya karoge?

Jawab

✓ Development aur castling pehle

  • Tempo aur king safety aksar ek pawn se zyada keemti.

2.6.6 Sawal 3: Kaunsa principle sahi nahi?

Kaunsa principle sahi nahi?

Jawab

✓ Ek hi piece baar-baar chalao

  • Opening mein har piece ek baar chalao, ek ko baar-baar nahi.

2.6.7 Abhyaas: White ki queen jaldi aa gayi

White ki queen jaldi aa gayi. Developing chaal se use bhagao (tempo jeeto).

Jawab dekho

1… Nf6

2.7

Shuruaati traps aur pitfalls

Fool's mate, Scholar's mate, early queen, f6, Legal, Blackburne Shilling

Yaad rakho
  • Traps jaano taaki unme na phanso, aur opponent phanse to saza do.
  • Fool's mate: f-pawn aur g-pawn jaldi mat hilao (e1-h4 diagonal khulta hai).
  • f7/f2 sabse kamzor square: sirf king bachata hai.
  • e5 ko f6 se mat bachao (Damiano): king khul jaata hai.
  • Lalach (Bxd1 ya Nxe5 jaisi free cheezein) se pehle socho: kahin trap to nahi?

2.7.1 Traps kyun seekhein?

  • Trap = aisi chaal jo achhi dikhti hai par galat jawab par turant jeet deti hai.
  • Traps seekhne ke 2 fayde:
    • Bachaav: tum un mein nahi phansoge.
    • Hamla: opponent phanse to tum saza doge.
  • Par trap ke liye apni position kharab mat karo.
  • Achhi chaalein khelo jo trap bhi set karein.

2.7.2 Sabse chhota game: Fool's mate

  • Notation padh kar game samjho.
  • Yeh duniya ka sabse chhota checkmate hai (sirf 2 chaal).

1. f3 e5 2. g4 Qh4#

  • 1.f3? King ke saamne ka pawn kamzor kiya.
  • 1...e5 Black ne center liya aur queen ka raasta khola.
  • 2.g4?? Bahut badi galti! e1-h4 diagonal poora khul gaya.
  • 2...Qh4# Checkmate! Seekh: opening mein f aur g pawns ko faltu mat chalao.

2.7.3 Fool's mate pattern: Teed vs Delmar (1896)

  • Same idea: Black ne f aur g pawns aage karke king ko khol diya.

1. d4 f5 2. Bg5 h6 3. Bh4 g5 4. Bg3 f4 5. e3 h5 6. Bd3 Rh6 7. Qxh5+ Rxh5 8. Bg6#

  • 1...f5 Dutch: king ke paas ka pawn.
  • 4...f4? pawns aur aage.
  • 6...Rh6 rook bhi bahar, par king ka diagonal khula hai.
  • 7.Qxh5+!! queen sacrifice.
  • 8.Bg6# e8-h5 diagonal khula tha. Mate!

2.7.4 Fool's mate pattern: Greco vs NN (1620)

  • 400 saal purana game: f-pawn ki galti se wahi diagonal khula.

1. e4 b6 2. d4 Bb7 3. Bd3 f5 4. exf5 Bxg2 5. Qh5+ g6 6. fxg6 Nf6 7. gxh7+ Nxh5 8. Bg6#

  • 3...f5? king ka diagonal khula.
  • 5.Qh5+ check!
  • 6.fxg6 ab gxh7+ ki threat.
  • 6...Nf6 queen par attack.
  • 7.gxh7+! discovered check: bishop d3 ka check!
  • 8.Bg6# Mate!

2.7.5 Early queen trap: `2.Qh5` ke baad `g6??`

  • 2.Qh5 ek kamzor opening hai, par 2...g6?? aur bhi badi galti.

1. e4 e5 2. Qh5 g6 3. Qxe5+ Qe7 4. Qxh8

  • 2.Qh5 e5 aur f7 par nazar.
  • 2...g6?? queen ko bhagaya par e5 bhool gaye.
  • 3.Qxe5+ fork: king aur h8 rook!
  • 4.Qxh8 rook gaya.

2.7.6 Abhyaas: Tum Black ho

Tum Black ho. White ne 2.Qh5 khela. Sabse achha jawab: e5 bachao aur develop karo.

Jawab dekho

1… Nc6

Ye bhi sahi: Qe7 d6 Qf6

  • 2...Nc6! e5 protect aur development.
  • Phir 3.Bc4 g6! (ab safe) 4.Qf3 Nf6 aur White ki queen ka time barbaad.

2.7.7 Scholar's mate: trap aur bachaav

  • Yeh beginner ka sabse common trap hai.
  • Dekho aur phir bachna seekho.

1. e4 e5 2. Bc4 Nc6 3. Qh5 Nf6 4. Qxf7#

  • 2.Bc4 bishop f7 ko dekh raha hai. f7 sirf king protect karta hai: kamzor square.
  • 3.Qh5 queen + bishop dono f7 par. Saath mein e5 par bhi attack.
  • 3...Nf6?? Knight ne queen ko attack kiya, par f7 bhool gaya.
  • 4.Qxf7# Checkmate. Seekh: f7/f2 square ko dhyan se protect karo.

2.7.8 Abhyaas: Black ho

Black ho. White ne Qh5 khela. Mate se bachao aur e5 bhi bachao.

Jawab dekho

1… g6

Ye bhi sahi: Qe7 Qf6

  • 3...g6! queen ko bhagata hai.
  • 3...Qe7 bhi theek hai.
  • Phir Nf6 aur development: White ki queen ka time waste hua.

2.7.9 Scholar's mate ka rook-fork version

  • Opponent ki nakal mat karo.
  • 2...Bc5 ke baad 3.Qh5: ab 3...g6?? phir fork.

1. e4 e5 2. Bc4 Bc5 3. Qh5 g6 4. Qxe5+ Qe7 5. Qxh8

  • 2...Bc5 nakal. Behtar: 2...Nf6! (Tarrasch: "knights before bishops").
  • 3.Qh5 f7 aur e5 dono par attack.
  • 3...g6?? (sahi: 3...Qe7)
  • 4.Qxe5+ fork: king, rook h8 (aur bishop c5).
  • 5.Qxh8 Rook gaya.

2.7.10 f6 se e5 bachana: Damiano ki galti

  • 2...f6? king ka pawn shield kamzor karta hai.

1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 f6 3. Nxe5 fxe5 4. Qh5+ g6 5. Qxe5+ Qe7 6. Qxh8

  • 2...f6? behtar 2...Nc6.
  • 3.Nxe5! knight sacrifice.
  • 3...fxe5? (3...Qe7 behtar)
  • 4.Qh5+ king khula hai.
  • 4...g6 (4...Ke7 5.Qxe5+ Kf7 6.Bc4+ aur bhayankar attack)
  • 5.Qxe5+ fork!
  • 6.Qxh8 Rook gaya, White material mein aage.

2.7.11 King's Gambit: `fxe5` trap

  • Black gambit lene ki jagah 2...Nc6 khelta hai.
  • Agar White 3.fxe5??...

1. e4 e5 2. f4 Nc6 3. fxe5 Qh4+ 4. g3 Qxe4+ 5. Qe2 Qxh1

  • 2...Nc6 simple development.
  • 3.fxe5?? lalach.
  • 3...Qh4+! king ka diagonal khula hai.
  • 4.g3 (4.Ke2 Qxe4+ 5.Kf2 Bc5+ aur bhi bura)
  • 4...Qxe4+ fork: king aur rook h1.
  • 5…Qxh1 Rook gaya.

2.7.12 Legal's mate (trap)

  • Ek famous opening trap jahan White queen sacrifice karta hai.

1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 d6 3. Bc4 Bg4 4. Nc3 g6 5. Nxe5 Bxd1 6. Bxf7+ Ke7 7. Nd5#

  • 3...Bg4 knight ko pin kiya (relative pin, peeche queen).
  • 4...g6? slow chaal.
  • 5.Nxe5! Pin tod diya! Queen de di.
  • 5...Bxd1?? Lalach. 5...dxe5 behtar tha.
  • 6.Bxf7+ King ko bahar kheencha.
  • 7.Nd5# Teen minor pieces ka mate!

2.7.13 Abhyaas: Legal trap ke baad

Legal trap ke baad: Black ne queen le li (5...Bxd1). Mate in 2!

Jawab dekho

1. Bxf7+ Ke7 2. Nd5#

  • 6.Bxf7+ Ke7 7.Nd5#.
  • Teen minor pieces ne mate kiya, queen ki zaroorat hi nahi.

2.7.14 Blackburne Shilling trap

  • 3...Nd4 ek trick hai.
  • Agar White lalach kare to mate!

1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bc4 Nd4 4. Nxe5 Qg5 5. Nxf7 Qxg2 6. Rf1 Qxe4+ 7. Be2 Nf3#

  • 3...Nd4?! pawn e5 "free" lagta hai.
  • 4.Nxe5? lalach. Behtar: 4.Nxd4 ya 4.O-O.
  • 4...Qg5! g2 aur e5 par attack.
  • 5.Nxf7?? aur lalach.
  • 5...Qxg2
  • 6.Rf1
  • 6...Qxe4+
  • 7.Be2
  • 7...Nf3# Smothered mate! Seekh: opponent ki trick chaal par pehle socho "kyun?".

2.7.15 Sawal 1: Trap se bachne ka sabse achha general tareeka?

Trap se bachne ka sabse achha general tareeka?

Jawab

✓ "Free" material lene se pehle opponent ki threat (checks, captures, threats) dekho

  • Aksar trap tab lagta hai jab hum lalach mein opponent ki agli chaal nahi dekhte.

2.8

Sochne ka tareeka: forcing moves (CCT)

Checks, Captures, Threats

Yaad rakho
  • Har chaal se pehle CCT: Checks, Captures, Threats.
  • Pehle apne liye, phir opponent ke liye socho.
  • Aakhir mein blunder check: meri chaal se kuch hanging to nahi?
  • Opponent ki har chaal par poocho: "Iski threat kya hai?"
  • Hum computer nahi: isliye pehle forcing moves (checks, captures, threats) dekho. Yeh opponent ke jawab seemit karti hain.
  • Sabse forcing: double check, phir check, phir capture, phir badi threat (mate in 1-2, queen par attack).
  • Kabhi quiet (shaant) chaal forcing se behtar hoti hai: CCT jaagrukta ke liye hai, andhadhundh khelne ke liye nahi.

  2. 2.8.2 Abhyaas: CCT use karo
  3. 2.8.3 Sawal 1: Opponent ne abhi apni queen tumhare king ke paas laayi
  4. 2.8.4 Forcing moves pehle kyun?
  5. 2.8.5 Abhyaas: Pehle saare checks dekho
  6. 2.8.6 Abhyaas: Pehle saare checks dekho
  7. 2.8.7 Abhyaas: Pehle saare checks dekho
  8. 2.8.8 Abhyaas: Pehle saare checks dekho

2.8.1 Har chaal se pehle CCT

  • Grandmasters bhi har position mein pehle forcing moves dekhte hain:
    • Checks: kya main check de sakta hoon?
    • Captures: kya main kuch capture kar sakta hoon?
    • Threats: kya main koi bada attack bana sakta hoon (mate threat, queen par attack)?
  • Phir yahi opponent ke liye socho: woh kya karna chahta hai?
  • Aakhir mein blunder check: "Kya meri chaal se koi piece hanging hoga?"

2.8.2 Abhyaas: CCT use karo

CCT use karo: pehle saare checks dekho. Sabse achhi chaal?

Jawab dekho

1. Qd5+

  • Qd5+ check deta hai aur a8 rook par bhi attack.
  • King hatega, phir Qxa8+.
  • Checks pehle dekhne se yeh turant milta hai.

2.8.3 Sawal 1: Opponent ne abhi apni queen tumhare king ke paas laayi

Opponent ne abhi apni queen tumhare king ke paas laayi. Sabse pehle kya socho?

Jawab

✓ Woh kya threat bana raha hai (mate?)

  • Opponent ki threat dekhna = aadhe blunders khatam.

2.8.4 Forcing moves pehle kyun?

  • Computer har second laakhon positions dekhta hai, hum nahi.
  • Hum is kami ko poora karte hain forcing moves ko pehle dekh kar: Checks, Captures, Threats (jaise mate in 1-2, queen par attack).
  • Forcing chaal opponent ke jawab bahut kam kar deti hai, isliye aage tak calculate karna aasaan ho jaata hai.
  • Sabse forcing: double check (king ko hilna hi padega).
  • Par yaad rakho: CCT jaagrukta hai.
  • Kabhi ek shaant (quiet) chaal best hoti hai.

Pehle saare checks dekho. Mate in 1!

  • Rxb8# checkmate.
  • Checks pehle dekhne se aisi chaalein nahi chhoot-ti.

Level 3

Middlegame 1: Tactics

Sochne ki process, fork, pin, skewer, discovered attack, defender hatao, deflection, decoy, interference, clearance, x-ray, calculation

  • Middlegame section (Level 3-5) yahan se shuru.
  • Middlegame woh hissa hai jab pieces bahar aa chuke hain aur asli ladaai hoti hai: tactics, mate attacks aur plans.
  • Pehla hissa tactics: chhoti forcing chaalon se material ya mate jeetna.
  • Pehle sochne ki process, phir har hathiyaar alag se, aur bahut saare puzzles.
3.1

Middlegame mein sochne ki process

Processes vs patterns, downsides, defensive hero, ek-chaal ka game

Yaad rakho
  • Process (calculation, evaluation, visualization) aur pattern (fork, pin, mate patterns) alag cheezein hain. Dono chahiye.
  • Chess "single-turn" game hai: ek chaal mein do threats = opponent ek hi bacha payega (double attack ka raaz).
  • Evaluation mein opponent ke downsides dhundo: unprotected pieces, kamzor king.
  • Calculation ek "draft story" hai: jo defensive hero tumhari story bigaadta hai, use hatao.
  • Forcing moves dekho, par kabhi quiet chaal aur kabhi aur aage calculate karna behtar.
Is lesson ke topics
  1. 3.1.1 Processes aur patterns
  2. 3.1.2 Chess ek-chaal ka game hai
  3. 3.1.3 Sawal 1: Opponent ki do cheezon par ek saath threat hai, aur koi ek chaal…
  4. 3.1.4 Downsides ka jashn: unprotected pieces aur king
  5. 3.1.5 Defensive hero ko hatao
  6. 3.1.6 Sawal 2: Tumhari mate ki line mein ek black knight f6 square h7 ko bacha…
  7. 3.1.7 Facts awareness

3.1.1 Processes aur patterns

  • Process = sochne ka tareeka, kisi bhi position mein: forcing moves (checks, captures, threats) dekhna, calculation (aage ki chaalein sochna), visualization (dimaag mein board), evaluation (line ke end mein kaun behtar: material, king safety, pawn structure).
  • Pattern = jaani-pehchaani shakal: fork, pin, deflection, mate patterns.
  • Pattern pata na ho tab bhi process se jeet sakte ho.
  • Aur patterns process ko tez karte hain.

3.1.2 Chess ek-chaal ka game hai

  • Har chaal mein opponent sirf ek kaam kar sakta hai.
  • Agar tum ek chaal se do threats banao, aur koi ek chaal dono ko na roke, to ek cheez jaayegi.
  • Isliye double attack (fork) sabse important tactic hai.
  • Kabhi double attack ek piece nahi karta: ek piece hatne se peeche wale ka attack khulta hai (discovered attack).

3.1.3 Sawal 1: Opponent ki do cheezon par ek saath threat hai, aur koi ek chaal…

Opponent ki do cheezon par ek saath threat hai, aur koi ek chaal dono nahi bachati. Kyun jeet hoti hai?

Jawab

✓ Kyunki chess mein ek turn mein ek hi chaal hoti hai

  • Single-turn game: ek chaal = ek bachaav.

3.1.4 Downsides ka jashn: unprotected pieces aur king

  • Position dekh kar pehle opponent ki kamzoriyan (downsides) dhundo:
    • Unprotected pieces: sabse classic downside. Kabhi seedha nahi pakad sakte, use doosre downside (jaise check) mein badalna padta hai.
    • King safety: khula king, kamzor back rank, pawns aage badhe hue.
  • Calculation in downsides ko ubhaarne ka tool hai.
  • Pata ho ki kya dhundh rahe ho, to aur aage tak dekh paate ho.

3.1.5 Defensive hero ko hatao

  • Calculation ek draft story jaisi hai.
  • Aksar story mein ek defensive hero hota hai: woh ek piece jo tumhara plan bigaad deta hai (mate square bachata hai, piece ko protect karta hai).
  • Story dobara likho: pehle hero ko capture karo, bhagao, ya bhatkao (removing the defender, deflection), phir plan chalao.

3.1.6 Sawal 2: Tumhari mate ki line mein ek black knight f6 square h7 ko bacha…

Tumhari mate ki line mein ek black knight f6 square h7 ko bacha raha hai. Pehle kya socho?

Jawab

✓ Knight (defensive hero) ko kaise hatayein

  • Defender hatao, phir mate.

3.1.7 Facts awareness

  • Har forcing chaal khelni zaroori nahi: kabhi quiet chaal (jo badi threat banaye) zyada strong.
  • Opponent ki threat aur trap se jaagruk raho, par darr ke ruk mat jao: kabhi aur aage calculate karo to dikhega ki "khatra" asli nahi.

3.2

Fork (do pe ek saath attack)

Knight, queen aur pawn forks

Yaad rakho
  • Fork = ek piece se do ya zyada pieces par ek saath attack.
  • Knight fork sabse khatarnaak: uska attack block nahi hota.
  • Best fork = check + kuch aur: pehle king bachana padta hai.
  • Pawn aur queen bhi fork karte hain. Royal fork = king + queen.
  • Fork = double attack. King + kuch aur par fork sabse strong (check ka jawab dena padta hai).
  • Pawn bhi fork karta hai. Fork se pawn ko promote karne ka raasta bhi ban sakta hai.
  • Famous: Petrosian-Spassky, Petrosian-Simagin, Botvinnik-Kotov, Anand-Kasparov, Tal-Pliss (pawn fork).

3.2.1 Fork kya hai

  • Fork = ek piece se do ya zyada dushman pieces par ek saath attack.
  • Opponent ek hi bacha sakta hai.
  • Knight fork sabse khatarnaak hota hai kyunki knight ka attack block nahi hota.
  • Sabse best fork: king + kuch aur (check ke saath), kyunki check pehle bachana padta hai.

3.2.6 Masters ke forks

  • Fork har level par aata hai:
    • Petrosian vs Spassky, Petrosian vs Simagin, Botvinnik vs Kotov: knight aur queen ke forks se material.
    • Avrukh vs Kamsky: fork se pawn ko queen banane ka raasta saaf.
    • Aronian vs Seel, Anand vs Kasparov, Keene vs Botvinnik.
    • Tal vs Pliss: "pawns bhi fork karte hain!"
  • Ab khud karo: aur forks.

3.3

Pin

Piece hil nahi sakta

Yaad rakho
  • Pin: aage wala piece hil nahi sakta kyunki peeche zyada keemti piece hai.
  • Absolute pin (peeche king): kanoonan hil nahi sakta. Relative pin (peeche queen/rook): hilega to nuksaan.
  • Pinned piece par aur attack karo (aksar pawn se).
  • Bishop, rook, queen hi pin karte hain.
  • Absolute pin: peeche king, pinned piece chal hi nahi sakta. Relative pin: peeche queen/rook, chal sakta hai par nuksaan.
  • Relative pin kabhi tod sakte ho (rebel) agar badle mein bada fayda ho (Legal trap, Popov-Petkovski).
  • Pinned piece defender nahi raha: pin se mate ya material jeeto (Nimzowitsch-Rubinstein).

3.3.1 Pin kya hai

  • Pin = ek piece hil nahi sakta (ya hilna nahi chahiye) kyunki uske peeche zyada keemti piece hai.
  • Absolute pin: peeche king hai. Pinned piece kanoonan hil hi nahi sakta.
  • Relative pin: peeche queen/rook hai. Hil sakta hai par nuksaan hoga.
  • Pin ka fayda: pinned piece par aur attack karo (jaise pawn se).

Pin karke queen jeeto.

Jawab dekho

1. Bd4

  • Bd4! queen h8 king ke saath pin hai.
  • Woh hat nahi sakti: Qxd4 cxd4 ke baad Black ne queen (9) dekar bishop (3) liya.

3.3.3 Abhyaas: Pinned knight par attack karo!

Pinned knight par attack karo!

Jawab dekho

1. d5

  • d5! knight pinned hai (peeche king).
  • Woh bhaag nahi sakta, agli chaal dxc6 se piece jeet.

3.3.4 Sawal 1: Yahan c6 ka knight kis type ke pin mein hai?

Yahan c6 ka knight kis type ke pin mein hai?

Jawab

✓ Absolute pin (peeche king)

  • Bb5 se e8 king tak diagonal: knight beech mein hai aur kanoonan hil nahi sakta.

3.3.5 Pin ke prakaar

  • Absolute pin: peeche king. Pinned piece chal hi nahi sakta (illegal).
  • Relative pin: peeche queen ya rook. Chal sakta hai, par peeche wala jaayega.
  • Relative pin se bagawat: kabhi pinned piece chala do agar badle mein mate ya bada fayda ho (Legal trap mein Nxe5!, Popov vs Petkovski).
  • Pin ka jashn: pinned piece "nakli defender" hai. Us par aur attackers lao (Nimzowitsch vs Rubinstein: pin se mate force).
  • Examples: Nimzowitsch-Nielsen (defensive hero ko pin karke hataaya), Bronstein-Goldenov (pin se key square par kabza), Xie Jun-Yu Lefu.

3.3.6 Elephant trap (Queen's Gambit Declined): pin jo pin nahi tha

  • White ko laga f6 knight pinned hai aur d5 pawn free hai.
  • Par Black ka jawab tayyar tha.

1. d4 d5 2. c4 e6 3. Nc3 Nf6 4. Bg5 Nbd7 5. cxd5 exd5 6. Nxd5 Nxd5 7. Bxd8 Bb4+ 8. Qd2 Bxd2+ 9. Kxd2 Kxd8

  • 4...Nbd7 trap set.
  • 6.Nxd5?? "knight pinned hai" soch kar pawn liya.
  • 6...Nxd5! relative pin todi! Queen de di.
  • 7.Bxd8
  • 7...Bb4+! check.
  • 8.Qd2 sirf yahi.
  • 8...Bxd2+
  • 9...Kxd8 Black ek piece aage.

3.3.7 Sawal 2: Pinned piece ke peeche king hai

Pinned piece ke peeche king hai. Kya woh chal sakta hai?

Jawab

✓ Nahi, illegal hai

  • Absolute pin.

3.4

Skewer

Ulta pin

Yaad rakho
  • Skewer = ulta pin: keemti piece aage (aksar king), kam keemti peeche.
  • Aage wala hatega, peeche wala capture.
  • Line pieces (rook, bishop, queen) hi skewer karte hain.
  • Skewer = ulta pin: aage bada piece (king/queen), hatega to peeche wala jaayega.
  • Famous: Short-Vaganian, Kasparov-Tatai, Fischer-Stepans, Carlsen-Anand, Kramnik-Nakamura.

  • Skewer pin ka ulta hai: keemti piece aage hai (aksar king), aur kam keemti peeche.
  • Aage wala hatega, to peeche wala capture.
  • Rooks, bishops aur queens skewer karte hain (seedhi line wale pieces).

3.5

Discovered attack aur double check

Chhupa hua attack

Yaad rakho
  • Discovered attack: aage wala piece hate to peeche wale ka attack khul jaata hai.
  • Hatne wala piece bhi kuch attack kare = do threats ek saath.
  • Double check ka jawab sirf king ko hatana hai: block ya capture nahi.
  • Discovered attack: aage wala piece hat-ta hai aur khud bhi kuch attack karta hai = do threats.
  • Discovered check sabse khatarnak: aage wala piece kuch bhi le sakta hai.
  • Famous: Reti-Tartakower, Bronstein-Geller, Fischer-Spassky 1972 (game 8), Kasparov-Karpov.

3.5.1 Discovered attack

  • Jab ek piece hatta hai aur uske peeche wale piece ka attack khul jaata hai, use discovered attack kehte hain.
  • Agar khula attack king par ho to discovered check.
  • Khatarnaak kyunki hatne wala piece bhi kuch attack kar sakta hai: do threats ek saath!
  • Double check: dono pieces check dein.
  • Iska jawab sirf king ko hatana hai.

3.6

Defender hatao aur overloading

Removing the defender (undermining), overloaded piece

Yaad rakho
  • Removing the defender: bachaane wale piece ko capture karo ya bhagao.
  • Deflection: defender ko zabardasti door le jao.
  • Overloading: ek defender ke do kaam, ek par vaar karo.
  • Decoy: dushman piece ko kharab square par lalchao.
  • Removing the defender (undermining / removing the guard): defender ko capture karo ya bhagao.
  • Overloading: ek piece ke paas do kaam; ek kaam par hamla karo, doosra chhoot jaayega.
  • Examples: Tseshkovsky-Kasparov, Karjakin-Short, Adams-Whiteley, Uhlmann-Schwartz.

3.6.1 Defender ko hatao

  • Removing the defender: jo piece kisi square/piece ko bacha raha hai, use capture karo ya bhagao.
  • Deflection: defender ko zabardasti door le jao (aksar sacrifice se).
  • Overloading: ek defender ke paas do kaam hain. Ek kaam par attack karo, doosra khul jaayega.
  • Decoy: dushman piece ko kharab square par lalchao (sacrifice se).

3.7

Deflection aur decoy

Defender ko door bhagao, ya dushman piece ko kharab square par kheencho

Yaad rakho
  • Deflection: defender ko uski duty se door kheencho (aksar sacrifice se).
  • Decoy: dushman piece (aksar king/queen) ko kisi kharab square par laao, phir fork/skewer/mate.
  • Famous deflection: Timman-Yusupov, Zukertort-Blackburne, Velimirovic-Csom, Botvinnik-Keres, Tal-Averbakh.
  • Famous decoy: Bjornsson-Tal, Nimzowitsch-Mieses, Seirawan-Polgar, Letelier-Fischer, Korchnoi-Tal, Polgar-Hansen.

3.7.1 Deflection

  • Deflection = defender ko uske kaam se door le jao.

3.7.8 Decoy (attraction)

  • Decoy = sacrifice se dushman ke piece (aksar king ya queen) ko ek kharab square par kheencho.
  • Wahan fork, skewer, pin ya mate ho jaata hai.
  • Examples: Bjornsson-Tal, Nimzowitsch-Mieses, Seirawan-Polgar, Letelier-Fischer, Nei-Petrosian, Spassky-Averkin, Korchnoi-Tal, Larsen-Spassky, Kosten-Chandler, Kotronias-Vallejo, Polgar-Hansen.

3.7.9 Sawal 1: Deflection aur decoy mein farak?

Deflection aur decoy mein farak?

Jawab

✓ Deflection defender ko kisi jagah se hatata hai, decoy dushman piece ko kisi jagah par laata hai

  • Deflection = "wahan se hatao", decoy = "yahan laao".

3.8

Interference, clearance, x-ray, zwischenzug

Lines kaatna aur kholna, aar-paar attack, beech ki chaal

Yaad rakho
  • Zwischenzug: recapture se pehle ek zyada forcing chaal.
  • X-ray: piece dushman piece ke aar-paar square control karta hai.
  • Interference: do dushman pieces ke beech apna piece rakh kar connection kaato.
  • Clearance, desperado, perpetual check: ye bhi yaad rakho.
  • Interference (disconnection, "spanner"): do dushman pieces ke beech apna piece rakh kar unka connection kaato.
  • Clearance (line clearance): apna hi piece raaste se hatao (aksar tempo ke saath) taaki doosre piece ki line khule.
  • X-ray: piece doosre piece ke aar-paar square ko control/support karta hai.
  • Zwischenzug: expected recapture se pehle ek zyada forcing chaal.

  11. 3.8.11 Diagram: X-ray: Rd1 ka attack apne Rd2 ke aar-paar d8 tak (doubling)

3.8.1 Advanced motifs

  • Zwischenzug (in-between move): expected recapture ki jagah pehle ek zyada forcing chaal (check/threat) khelo.
  • X-ray: piece dushman piece ke aar-paar ek square ko control karta hai.
  • Interference: do dushman pieces ke beech mein apna piece rakh kar unka connection kaato.
  • Clearance: apne hi piece ko hata kar line/square khaali karo.
  • Desperado: jo piece waise bhi jaane wala hai, use jitna ho sake mehenga becho.
  • Perpetual check: haarti position mein lagaataar check de kar draw.

3.8.2 Sawal 1: Opponent ne tumhara knight capture kiya

Opponent ne tumhara knight capture kiya. Recapture ki jagah tum pehle check dete ho jo queen ko bhi attack karta hai. Yeh kya kehlata hai?

Jawab

✓ Zwischenzug

  • In-between move: pehle bada threat, recapture baad mein.

3.8.3 Sawal 2: Tum haar rahe ho, par opponent ke king ko lagaataar check de sakte ho

Tum haar rahe ho, par opponent ke king ko lagaataar check de sakte ho. Kya milega?

Jawab

✓ Draw (perpetual check / repetition)

  • Lagaataar checks se same position repeat hoti hai = draw.

3.8.4 Interference (spanner in the works)

  • Do dushman pieces ek doosre ko support kar rahe hain (jaise do rooks, ya rook jo mate square bachata hai).
  • Unke beech mein apna piece rakho: ab line kat gayi.
  • Use capture karne mein bhi line aksar band rehti hai.
  • Examples: Miles-Pritchett, Piket-Kramnik, Kramnik-Topalov, Koskinen-Kasman, Karpov-Polgar.

3.8.5 Sawal 3: Black ka rook b8 aur queen g8 ek doosre ko back rank par bachate hain

Black ka rook b8 aur queen g8 ek doosre ko back rank par bachate hain. Tum e8 par piece rakh do jo dono line kaat de. Yeh kaunsa tactic?

Jawab

✓ Interference

  • Line ke beech piece rakhna = interference.

3.8.6 Clearance (line kholna)

  • Kabhi apna hi piece raasta rok raha hota hai.
  • Use tempo ke saath (check, capture ya threat se) hatao taaki queen/rook/bishop ki line khul jaaye, ya square khaali ho jaaye.
  • Examples: Keene-Briant, Karjakin-Komiliakov, La Bourdonnais-McDonnell.

3.8.7 Sawal 4: Tumhari queen ki h-file par tumhara apna knight h5 baitha hai

Tumhari queen ki h-file par tumhara apna knight h5 baitha hai. Knight check dekar hatta hai aur queen h7 par mate karti hai. Yeh kya hai?

Jawab

✓ Clearance

  • Apna piece hata kar line kholna = clearance.

3.8.8 X-ray

  • Piece doosre piece ke aar-paar dekhta hai.
  • Jaise rook queen ke peeche ho (battery): queen trade hone par rook usi square ko support karta hai.
  • Examples: Fischer-Bisguier, Euwe-Loman, Ivanchuk-Van Wely, Mamedyarov-Carlsen.

3.8.9 Abhyaas: X-ray: queens aamne-saamne, dono ke peeche rooks

X-ray: queens aamne-saamne, dono ke peeche rooks. Kaun jeetega? Chaal chalo.

Jawab dekho

1. Qxd6 Rxd6 2. Rxd6

  • Qxd6 Rxd6 Rxd6.
  • d1 rook ne queen ke aar-paar d6 ko support kiya.
  • White ek rook aage.

3.8.10 Abhyaas: Zwischenzug!

Zwischenzug! Black ne tumhari queen d2 par le li. Recapture se pehle ek zyada forcing chaal?

Jawab dekho

1. Rxe8+ Kh7 2. Nxd2

  • Pehle Rxe8+ (check ke saath rook), phir Nxd2 se queen wapas.
  • Seedha Nxd2?? par Rxe1+ aur tum peeche.

3.9

Calculation ke 3 golden rules

Pichli chaal ki kamzori, killer common squares, in-effect clause, squares ka pyaar

Yaad rakho
  • Rule 1: Opponent ki pichli chaal ne kya kamzor chhoda? (square, piece, line)
  • Rule 2: Killer common squares: jahan tumhare do pieces mil kar attack karte hain, wahan sacrifice ya mate aksar kaam karta hai.
  • Rule 3: In-effect clause: har chaal ka poore board par asar dekho (discovered lines, khule raaste, open/closed position).
  • Teeno ka raaz ek: chess squares ka khel hai. Jeetne ke liye key squares tak pahuncho.
Is lesson ke topics
  1. 3.9.1 Calculation kya hai?
  2. 3.9.2 Rule 1: Pichli chaal ki kamzori
  3. 3.9.3 Rule 2: Killer common squares
  4. 3.9.4 Abhyaas: Common square dhundo jahan tumhare pieces mil kar mate karein
  5. 3.9.5 Abhyaas: Common square dhundo jahan tumhare pieces mil kar mate karein
  6. 3.9.6 Abhyaas: Common square dhundo jahan tumhare pieces mil kar mate karein
  7. 3.9.7 Abhyaas: Common square dhundo jahan tumhare pieces mil kar mate karein
  8. 3.9.8 Rule 3: In-effect clause
  9. 3.9.9 Abhyaas: In-effect clause
  10. 3.9.10 Abhyaas: In-effect clause
  11. 3.9.11 Abhyaas: In-effect clause
  12. 3.9.12 Squares ka pyaar
  13. 3.9.13 Sawal 1: Teeno golden rules mein common cheez kya hai?

3.9.1 Calculation kya hai?

  • Calculation = aage ki chaalein dimaag mein khelna: meri chaal, opponent ka sabse achha jawab, phir meri... aur end mein evaluate karna.
  • Forcing moves se shuru karo kyunki unke jawab kam hote hain.
  • Is course ke teen golden rules calculation ko asaan banate hain.

3.9.2 Rule 1: Pichli chaal ki kamzori

  • Har chaal kuch naya kholti hai aur kuch chhodti hai.
  • Opponent ke chalne ke baad pucho:
    • Is piece ne kaunsa square/piece bachana chhod diya?
    • Kaunsi line khul gayi?
    • Kya koi piece ab unprotected hai?

3.9.3 Rule 2: Killer common squares

  • Woh squares jahan tumhare do (ya zyada) pieces ek saath pahunchte hain.
  • Wahan:
    • sacrifice karke bhi recapture ho jaata hai,
    • ek piece doosre ko support karke mate deta hai (jaise queen + bishop h7 par).
  • Kabhi common square shuru se hota hai, kabhi calculation ke beech banta hai.
  • Dovetail aur Mayet jaise mate patterns isi par chalte hain.

3.9.4 Abhyaas: Common square dhundo jahan tumhare pieces mil kar mate karein

Common square dhundo jahan tumhare pieces mil kar mate karein.

Jawab dekho

1. Qxc6+ Kd8 2. Qc7#

  • Line: Qxc6+ Kd8 Qc7#.
  • Do pieces ek hi square/area par mile: wahi killer common square.

Common square dhundo jahan tumhare pieces mil kar mate karein.

Jawab dekho

1. Qxf7#

  • Line: Qxf7#.
  • Do pieces ek hi square/area par mile: wahi killer common square.

Jawab dekho

1. Rc8+ Ne8 2. Rxe8#

  • Line: Rc8+ Ne8 Rxe8#.
  • Do pieces ek hi square/area par mile: wahi killer common square.

3.9.7 Abhyaas: Common square dhundo jahan tumhare pieces mil kar mate karein

Common square dhundo jahan tumhare pieces mil kar mate karein.

Jawab dekho

1… Qxf1+ 2. Kh2 Qh1#

  • Line: Qxf1+ Kh2 Qh1#.
  • Do pieces ek hi square/area par mile: wahi killer common square.

3.9.8 Rule 3: In-effect clause

  • Sirf jo piece chala uske arrows mat dekho.
  • Poore board par asar dekho:
    • Hatne se kaunsi line khuli (discovered effects)?
    • Kaunse doosre pieces azaad hue?
    • Pawns ka role: open position (khule raaste) mein tactics zyada, closed mein kam.

In-effect clause: chaal ka poore board par asar dekho.

Jawab dekho

  • Line: dxc5.
  • Ek chaal ne doosre piece ki line kholi.

Jawab dekho

  • Ek chaal ne doosre piece ki line kholi.

3.9.12 Squares ka pyaar

  • Teeno rules ek hi baat kehte hain: chess squares ka khel hai.
  • Pichli chaal ki kamzori = neglected squares, common squares = cooperation wale squares, in-effect = naye khule squares.
  • Spassky ne Fischer ke against 1972 mein ek ajeeb chaal se key squares jeete.

3.9.13 Sawal 1: Teeno golden rules mein common cheez kya hai?

✓ Squares par kabza

  • Chess is about squares.

3.10.1 Calculation kaise karein

Level 4

Middlegame 2: Checkmate patterns

Mate ki kala, back-rank, smothered, aur 25+ famous mate patterns

  • Mate patterns tactics ke "shortcut" hain: shakal pehchaan li to calculation turant ho jaati hai.
  • Har pattern ka naam, idea aur practice.
4.1

Mate patterns: shuruaat aur mate ki kala

Escape squares band karo, quiet moves, famous patterns

Yaad rakho
  • Strong players mate pattern pehchante hain, har baar calculate nahi karte.
  • Back-rank, smothered, Anastasia, Arabian, Boden: shakal yaad karo.
  • Legal's mate: pinned knight se queen sacrifice, teen minor pieces se mate.
  • Greek gift Bxh7+: tab jab f6 par black knight na ho aur Ng5 safe ho.
  • Philidor's legacy: Qg8+!! Rxg8 Nf7# smothered mate.
  • Mate ki kala: pehle king ke escape squares band karo, phir check.
  • Kabhi quiet chaal (bina check) mate se pehle zaroori hoti hai.
  • Escape squares band ho gaye par check nahi to naya check dhundo.
Is lesson ke topics
  1. 4.1.1 Patterns kyun?
  2. 4.1.2 Patterns = shortcuts
  3. 4.1.3 Abhyaas: Smothered mate in 1
  4. 4.1.4 Abhyaas: Anastasia mate in 1
  5. 4.1.5 Abhyaas: Arabian mate in 1
  6. 4.1.6 Abhyaas: Boden mate in 1
  7. 4.1.7 Abhyaas: Mate in 1
  8. 4.1.8 Abhyaas: Philidor's legacy (smothered mate)

  10. 4.1.10 Abhyaas: Mate in 2
  11. 4.1.11 Abhyaas: Mate in 2
  12. 4.1.12 Abhyaas: Mate in 2
  13. 4.1.13 Abhyaas: Mate in 2
  14. 4.1.14 Abhyaas: Mate in 2

4.1.1 Patterns kyun?

  • Checkmate pattern = pieces ki jaani-pehchaani shakal jo mate deti hai.
  • Pattern yaad ho to game mein dekhte hi pehchaan loge.
  • Mate ki kala:
  • 1.
  • King ke escape squares gino aur unhe ek-ek karke band karo.
  • 2.
  • Kabhi quiet chaal (check nahi) loud chaal se behtar: pehle jaal bichhao, phir check.
  • 3.
  • Saare escape squares band, par check nahi?
  • To naya check dhundo jo un squares ko band rakhe.

4.1.2 Patterns = shortcuts

  • Strong players har mate ko calculate nahi karte, woh pattern pehchante hain.
  • Yeh patterns yaad karo:
    • Back-rank mate: king apne pawns ke peeche band.
    • Smothered mate: king apne hi pieces se ghira, knight mate deta hai.
    • Anastasia mate: knight + rook, king kinare par.
    • Arabian mate: rook + knight corner mein.
    • Boden mate: do bishops criss-cross.
    • Legal mate: opening trap, queen sacrifice.
    • Greek gift: Bxh7+ sacrifice castled king par.

4.2

Back-rank mate

Apne hi pawns mein band king

Yaad rakho
  • King back rank par, aage apne pawns: rook ya queen ka check = mate.
  • Bachaav: "luft" (h3/h6 jaisi pawn chaal) se king ko saans do.
  • Defender ko hatao ya deflect karo, phir back rank par ghuso.
  • Famous: Carlsen-So, Bird-Zukertort, Averbakh-Ragozin, Polgar-Bareev, McShane-Mirumian, Bernstein-Capablanca.
Is lesson ke topics

4.2.1 Back-rank mate

  • King apni pehli (back) rank par hai aur aage apne hi pawns use rok rahe hain.
  • Rook ya queen ka back rank par check = mate.
  • Bachaav: waqt mile to h3/h6 jaisi chaal se king ko luft (saans) do.
  • Hamla: jo piece back rank bachata hai, use deflect ya overload karo.
  • Famous: Carlsen-So, Bird-Zukertort, Orbaan-Kramer, Averbakh-Ragozin (1954), Cooper-Ivanov, Shapiro-Silman, Polgar-Bareev, McShane-Mirumian, Davidovich-Aguado.

4.3

Smothered mate aur Philidor's legacy

Knight ka mate jab king apne pieces mein dab jaaye

Yaad rakho
  • Smothered mate: king ke saare squares apne pieces se bhare, knight check deta hai.
  • Philidor's legacy: queen check, knight checks, queen sacrifice g8 par, phir Nf7#.
  • Suffocation (semi-smothered) mate: knight + doosra piece, king apne pieces mein phansa.
  • Famous: McConnell-Morphy, Morphy vs NN (1856), Greco (1620), Morphy-Bryan (1859).

  2. 4.3.2 Abhyaas: Smothered mate in 1!

  5. 4.3.5 Suffocation mate (semi-smothered)

4.3.1 Smothered mate

  • King ke saare aas-paas ke squares apne hi pieces se bhare hain, aur knight check deta hai (knight ka check block nahi hota).
  • Sabse sundar mate!
  • Famous: McConnell-Morphy, Morphy vs NN (New Orleans 1856), NN-Greco (1620, 1625), Bird/Dobell vs NN, Bischoff-Mueller, Morphy-Bryan (1859), Hendriks-Welling.

4.4

Rook aur knight/bishop ke mate patterns

Anastasia, Arabian, corner, Morphy, Pillsbury, Mayet, Opera, blind swine, Reti, hook, Vukovic

Yaad rakho
  • Anastasia: knight e7 + rook h-file, king h7.
  • Arabian: rook h7 + knight f6, king h8.
  • Corner: rook g-file + knight f7, king h8 (pawn h7).
  • Morphy: bishop long diagonal se check, rook g-file band.
  • Pillsbury: rook g-file se check, bishop h8 band karta hai.
  • Mayet: rook check, door se bishop support.
  • Opera: rook back rank par, bishop support (Morphy ka Opera game).
  • Blind swine: do rooks 7th rank par.
  • Reti: bishop + rook, king apne pieces mein (Reti-Tartakower).
  • Hook: rook + knight + pawn ek chain. Vukovic: rook + knight, king kinare par.

  • Arabian: rook h7 + knight f6, king h8. Sabse purana pattern. (Gunsberg-Janowski)
  • Corner mate: rook g-file band kare, knight f7 se check, king h8 (pawn h7). (Myers-Poliakoff)
  • Morphy: bishop long diagonal se check, rook g-file band.
  • Pillsbury: ulta: rook g-file se check, bishop h8 band.
  • Mayet: rook check, door se bishop support (killer common square ka type).
  • Opera: rook back rank par check, bishop support. (Morphy ka Opera game)
  • Blind swine: do rooks 7th rank par ("pigs"), king ko maarte hain.
  • Reti: bishop + rook, king apne pieces mein (Reti-Tartakower).
  • Hook: rook ko knight protect kare, knight ko pawn: ek chain. (Marshall-Napier)
  • Vukovic: rook + knight, king kinare par. (Staunton-Williams)

4.5

Queen, bishop aur pawn ke mate patterns

Damiano, Greco, Lolli, dovetail, swallow's tail, epaulette, Boden, Blackburne, double bishop, Max Lange, kill box, pawn mate

Yaad rakho
  • Damiano: queen h7 par, pawn g6 support.
  • Greco: bishop g8 band kare, queen/rook h-file par mate.
  • Lolli: pawn f6 + queen g7 (thorn pawn).
  • Dovetail: queen diagonal se, king ke peeche ke squares apne pieces se band.
  • Swallow's tail (Gueridon): queen seedha saamne, king ke diagonal peeche apne rooks.
  • Epaulette: king ke dono taraf apne rooks (kandhe), queen saamne se.
  • Boden: do bishops crisscross (a6 + f4 jaisi diagonals).
  • Blackburne: do bishops + knight. Double bishop: do bishops saath diagonals par.
  • Max Lange: queen + bishop. Kill box: queen + rook ka box. Pawn mate (David & Goliath): pawn ka mate.
